finalText: The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount — contradicting its own comment ("tax what's actually owed"). Only order rows with both a discount *and* a tax exposed it, which is why it was hiding in the wall of text. Changed it to tax the discounted total. All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms it.
